C. Naturalism concerns the moral and political values that underpin international society, while positivism concerns the international rules as such, chiefly those in force through state consent in treaties and custom. That values-versus-positive-rules divide is the major difference between the two schools. A, B, and D misstate it: positivism turns on formal sources and consent, naturalism is a general foundation for legal obligation, and neither school is defined by a Europe/non-Europe split.

CONFIDENCE: 86
